lines.zh: 我裹着一层绒绒的褐丝。
lines.en: I am wrapped in fuzzy brown silk.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我就在叶背打转。
lines.en: A gust sets me spinning under the leaf.
I shift half an inch along the twig.
My cocoon brushes softly against the leaf.
I hang unsteadily and swing a lot.

lines.zh: 森林里的风总是斜着来。
lines.en: The wind in this forest always comes slantwise.

lines.zh: 我从一个结实的枝节挪开。
lines.en: I move off a stout joint of the branch.
Strands of brown silk lift in the wind.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转向叶柄的方向。
lines.en: I turn slowly toward the leaf stalk.
The branch dips, then slowly rises.

lines.zh: 我把自己藏在叶脉的凹处。
lines.en: I tuck myself into the hollow of a vein.

lines.zh: 我在枝叶之间换了位置。
lines.en: I have changed position among the twigs.
I am wrapped tight; the wind cannot get in.

lines.zh: 我一路挪到更高的枝上。
lines.en: I work my way to a higher branch.

lines.zh: 鸟翅的风把我吹得偏了。
lines.en: A bird's wingbeat blows me askew.

lines.zh: 我在这片叶下停了很久。
lines.en: I have paused a long while under this leaf.
I lie quietly wrapped in silk.
Something is slowly taking shape inside.
I count the leaf shadows.
Dew has caught on my fuzz.

lines.zh: 我等着一个湿润的清晨。
lines.en: I wait for a damp morning.
The forest light is soft as water.
I hear leaves rubbing together.
My silk has loosened slightly.

lines.zh: 我慢慢调整着里面的姿势。
lines.en: I slowly shift the posture within.

lines.zh: 叶片上的露水正往下走。
lines.en: Dew is running down the leaf.
An ant crawls across the leaf's underside.
I am quite secure on this twig.
Do you see this tuft of brown silk?
I am not a dead leaf.
Do not squeeze me in your hand.
The female moth is still growing inside.

lines.zh: 你靠近，我的影子就动了。
lines.en: As you come near, my shadow moves.
This leaf is my home.
I am hardly noticeable in this forest.
The mesh of that net is too fine.
I still have to stay a while.

lines.zh: 你抬头看树的动作被我发现了。
lines.en: I noticed you looking up into the tree.
A split has opened in the silk.
My swinging shakes the whole twig.
The cocoon's shell is layered with fuzz.
A sound is smothered inside the silk.
A layer of fuzz has come off.
I nearly slipped off the twig.
The silk walls have gone soft.
I barely held on and did not fall.
A damp mark is left on the leaf.

lines.zh: 茧壳厚，外面再冷也不怕。
lines.en: The cocoon is thick; outer cold can't reach me.
I am sealed in silk; I cannot eat.
Those leaves are for the caterpillars.

lines.zh: 你把东西举到枝下做什么？
lines.en: Why hold that up under the branch?
I cannot smell it; the silk blocks it.
Leave it. I have no use for it.
This silk is only waiting to break open.
Do not put your hand on the leaf stalk.
I prefer a quiet wood.
Two steps back and I am easy.
That smell is too strong.
The twig shook and my whole cocoon swung.

lines.zh: 丝壁凹进来一点，又弹回。
lines.en: The silk wall dents in, then springs back.
A little fuzz has rubbed off.
I draw back under the leaf.
That bump was fairly light.
I held my place and did not fall.
The branch tips, and I sway with it.

lines.zh: 这根枝太细，我们一起晃。
lines.en: The twig is too thin; we sway together.
Steady now. Don't sway.
Step back and the wind will settle me.

lines.zh: 雌蛾出来时会很有分量。
lines.en: When the female emerges, she will be heavy with eggs.
Keep watch over this tree.
When the silk splits, you will see.
Neither of us needs to speak.
Coming to look once a day is enough.

lines.zh: 这片林子够养活很多蛾。
lines.en: This wood can feed a great many moths.
Do not let anyone break this branch.
We both take our time.
The day the wind turns warm, it will be time.
When that comes, I may fly away.
I am caught in silk and cannot move.
Is that something you dropped?
It is hanging under the leaf stalk.
I touched it with my silk.
My silk is too soft to grip it.
It fell into the grass.
Do not reach over here.
That thing is glinting.
I have it braced against the leaf.
Leave it there; someone will pick it up.
I fix only on that patch of light.
The light fades, and it cools inside the cocoon.
I cannot chase anything.
My body is still wrapped in silk.
We shall see on the day I break out.
Half a step back will do.
This twig is my place.
I am not afraid of you, and I cannot flee.
Waiting for the mist to clear, waiting for dawn.
Come close; I will not move.
I watch which leaf you mean to touch.
Your hand has stalled there.
When the light changes, I know.
I can see even through the silk.
Do not touch that young twig.
My silk grows thinner.
A few more days and the time comes.
You wait, and so do I.
The wind comes from where you stand.

lines.zh: 你站那儿多久了，我看得见。
lines.en: I can tell how long you have stood there.
Stuffy in this cocoon, but safe.
This cocoon carries little weight.
One touch of your finger dents the silk.

lines.zh: 我把里面那团收得更小。
lines.en: I draw the mass inside even smaller.
I fell and landed on the leaf litter.
I only pull the silk tighter.
Your touch was light.
I have hidden on the underside.
There is a mark on my silk.
Let go and I will be fine.
The caterpillar spun me on a leaf.

lines.zh: 森林里多了一团褐色的茧。
lines.en: There is one more brown cocoon in the forest.
I hang beneath a low branch.
Silk has wrapped me round and round.
I hang quietly beneath the leaf.
Someone passed, and the leaf moved.
The cocoon splits; wings come out first.

lines.zh: 这是我最安静的一段日子。
lines.en: These are my quietest days.
Sunlight comes right through the leaf.
My fuzz looks very soft in the light.
The heat has curled my silk.

lines.zh: 我从枝上摔下来，丝磕破了。
lines.en: I fell from the branch and the silk split.
Waterlogged silk, heavy as lead.
The blast flips the whole branch up.
Something grazed my cocoon.
The change inside the silk has gone disordered.
I grow lighter and lighter inside the silk.

lines.zh: 一道白光照透了整个茧。
lines.en: A white flash shines right through the cocoon.

lines.zh: 我从枝上落下，一直往下。
lines.en: I fall from the branch and keep falling.
